Top 300 PERM Green Card Sponsors

The U.S. employers with the most PERM (green-card labor certification) filings in Department of Labor disclosure data, FY2008–FY2026. Together these 300 companies account for 583,772 PERM cases. Each profile shows filings by year, certification rate, cases currently pending with DOL (it is adjudicating December 2025 filings today), job titles, wages and H-1B salary data.
